_what: Hand-verified district spellings observed in real Port Sudan advert text that the generated zones.json canon does not carry. Consumed by scripts/crm/port-sudan-listings.ts.
_why_not_edit_zones_json: zones.json is emitted by `pnpm crm:ps-zones` and would lose hand edits on the next run. This file is a source, so it survives regeneration — the same reason sources/web-research.json exists alongside the generated rental-leads.json.
_rule: An alias enters ONLY with the advert it was observed in. A guessed alias silently mis-zones listings, and the zone density map is what the acquisition team plans routes around — a wrong row there is worse than an unplaced one.

aliases.why: zones.json carries 'حي الثورة', 'الثورات' and 'الثورة شرق' but not the bare form, which is how adverts actually write it.
Single-alef misspelling of سلالاب, used by the broker who holds the largest share of this board.
aliases.observed_text: قطعة ارض في سللاب مربع 6 ناصيه تفتح علي ظلط الأربعين

deliberately_not_aliased.why: Industrial City is a real named area — the discovery log lists it among the districts this market names for itself — but it is not one of the 45 residential zones in the canon. Mapping it to a neighbouring zone would invent a location. Left unplaced until the canon gains an industrial zone.

'Next to the Air Force College' is a landmark, not a district, and nothing fetched confirms which of the 45 zones that college sits in. Assigning it to airport-district on the strength of the word 'جوية' would be a guess.
